column2: Its juice is purple, turns red in acid and green to yellow in alkali, thanks to anthocyanins. Nearly everyone made it at school, so it's not the quirky answer it seems.
Its yellow pigment, curcumin, turns red-brown in alkali. That's why a curry stain goes red when you scrub it with soap.
